title: HAWAIʻI TOBACCO QUITLINE OFFERS FREE MOBILE APP TO HELP RESIDENTS QUIT TOBACCO
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawaiʻi Department of Health (DOH) is pleased to announce the launch of the Hawai‘i Tobacco Quitline mobile app, called Quitlogix. The app is a new evidence-based and Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA)-compliant resource that makes it easier than ever for adults to access free tobacco cessation support, directly from their […]
